therapy: ^"Welcome, Peggy and Rocky. It's nice to meet you both."
^"Therapy is a big step, and it’s one that can help us explore how you’re feeling and what’s been going on in your relationship."
^"Why don’t we start by sharing a little about how you two met? What brought you together?"
^"I was in the park. On a bench."
^"My family was arranging to marry me off to a very respectable pigeon with symmetrical wings."
